payload.text: A deviation attributed to a slide is separated from a deviation attributable to its capture POSITION before any floor is set. Only reordering separates them; no number of repeats at one order can. SATISFIED on the reverse-order run, whose CONCLUSION stands: with the capture budget held constant, the deviation followed the slide across both orders and the untouched slides were identical in both. Its NUMBERS are superseded -- that run predates 6c278a2 and carried pace=ambient. And a THIRD variable was held constant and is now known to matter: the capture MOMENT. The artefact migrates between slides as the budget changes, so this row rules out position and does not rule out budget.
